fusions.name: Cold Snap Tread
fusions.desc: Cold spreads from your step, dealing 3 frost damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each one [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Tail Whip
fusions.desc: Darts you to a target up to 4 tiles away, then sweeps its legs for 14 damage, leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds and knocks it back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Dropped Tail
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 control effects from you, and your movement speed rises 25% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Basking Stillness
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your next strike has 35% more critical hit chance. Once every 12 seconds.
